notes: Ten localized interaction episodes are identified. The double-door upper cabinet is represented as two events because its two separately hinged movable panels are visible open; their exact individual opening and closing order is under-sampled, so those timings have lower confidence.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a studio apartment documents interactions with an entry closet, kitchen appliances and storage, a refrigerator/freezer, and a laundry closet.
